body.p: Dion Charles Chewe MARTIN Appl. No. 18/329,065
Claims 1-15 are pending. Claims 9-15 stand withdrawn. In response to the Official
Action of February 2, 2024, and the requirement for restriction presented in it, Applicants elect Group I (claims 1-8). The election is made with traverse.

In particular, the Restriction Requirement fails to provide any evidence that there would be a serious burden examining all of the claims. Instead, page 2 of the Restriction Requirement only includes conclusory statements relating to burden. Withdrawal of the Restriction Requirement is requested.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency, or credit any
overpayment, in the fee(s) filed, or asserted to be filed, or which should have been filed herewith (or with any paper hereafter filed in this application by this firm) to our Account No. 14-1140.
